cash_flow_bridge.debt_service_assessment: Base FCFF provides limited coverage of CNY85.4bn net debt. If petrochemical margin remains weak or new-plant utilization disappoints, deleveraging depends on capex compression rather than natural earnings growth.

maintenance_capex_assumption.rationale: Large transfers to fixed assets and a heavy installed base make a low maintenance-capex assumption inappropriate. FCFF normalization remains execution-dependent until total capex falls toward this range.

cash_flow_bridge.permanent_loss_path: A cyclical profit decline combined with new depreciation, capex rigidity and high net debt first compresses FCFF and then magnifies the equity loss through enterprise value less net debt.

counterevidence.evidence: 2025 petrochemical revenue was CNY84.204bn while gross margin was only 0.58%.
counterevidence.item: Petrochemical scale has not converted into profit.
counterevidence.thesis_impact: This directly contradicts a bullish narrative that equates revenue or capacity growth with value creation.

counterevidence.evidence: 2025 OCF was CNY33.105bn and capex was CNY30.711bn, leaving CNY2.394bn.
counterevidence.item: Free cash flow is far weaker than operating cash flow.
counterevidence.thesis_impact: Even stable midpoint earnings may fail to create adequate shareholder cash or deleveraging capacity.

counterevidence.evidence: Conservative 2026Q1 net debt was about CNY85.4bn and the liability ratio was about 64.3%.
counterevidence.item: High net debt amplifies the cycle.
counterevidence.thesis_impact: A moderate enterprise-value reduction can cause a much larger per-share equity-value decline.

counterevidence.evidence: CNY57.577bn was transferred to fixed assets in 2025 and major year-end CIP remained CNY31.112bn; project-level ROIC is not disclosed.
counterevidence.item: Transferred and unfinished projects have not passed return validation.
counterevidence.thesis_impact: Future depreciation, under-utilization or further investment may make present earnings and FCFF assumptions too high.

counterevidence.evidence: 2026H1 improvement coincided with MDI/TDI price and supply disruptions, while standalone product profit is unavailable.
counterevidence.item: Bull-case evidence does not prove a permanent midpoint increase.
counterevidence.thesis_impact: Structural cost advantages cannot be separated from short-cycle gains, so peak annualization is not underwritable.

earnings_bridge.approach: Rebuild a cycle-midpoint profit from segment economics and capital intensity; do not annualize 2026H1 peak conditions.

capital_return.conclusion: The legacy group may earn around its cost of capital, but petrochemical and incremental project ROIC is unproven. Incremental capital value creation remains unresolved.

key_limitations: Standalone MDI and TDI profit is not disclosed, so the midpoint is estimated conservatively at segment level.
Maintenance capex is not separated, creating a large earnings-to-FCFF conversion error band.
Post-startup project EBIT, invested capital and utilization are absent, preventing a precise incremental ROIC calculation.

scenario_logic.base: Polyurethane retains technology and scale advantages without peak spreads, petrochemicals stay low-return and new materials improve slowly; normalized parent profit is CNY14.5bn.
scenario_logic.bear: Polyurethane spreads contract, petrochemicals remain near breakeven, and ramp depreciation consumes new-material growth; normalized parent profit is CNY10.5bn.
scenario_logic.bull: Polyurethane stays firm and new plants ramp well, but profit above CNY20bn is not made permanent; normalized parent profit is capped at CNY18.0bn.

evidence_ledger.finding: For 2025, polyurethane, petrochemical and new-material revenue was CNY75.058bn, CNY84.204bn and CNY33.189bn, with gross margins of 26.88%, 0.58% and 10.53%.
evidence_ledger.implication: Calculated segment gross profit is CNY20.176bn, CNY0.488bn and CNY3.495bn. Group economics remain concentrated in polyurethane while the largest revenue segment produces almost no gross profit.

evidence_ledger.finding: 2025 operating cash flow was CNY33.105bn and cash paid to acquire long-lived assets was CNY30.711bn, leaving only CNY2.394bn of reported free cash flow.
evidence_ledger.implication: Accounting earnings and OCF have not yet translated into distributable cash. The maintenance-versus-growth capex split is the primary underwriting gap.

evidence_ledger.finding: At 2026Q1, interest-bearing debt was about CNY134.76bn, cash plus trading financial assets was about CNY49.33bn, conservative net debt was about CNY85.4bn, and the liability ratio was about 64.3%.
evidence_ledger.implication: Net debt is material relative to normalized cash generation and creates nonlinear equity downside in a cyclical contraction.

evidence_ledger.finding: CNY57.577bn of construction in progress was transferred to fixed assets in 2025, while major year-end construction in progress still totaled about CNY31.112bn.
evidence_ledger.implication: Depreciation and remaining investment are not fully reflected in steady-state earnings or cash flow; weak utilization can depress future returns.

evidence_ledger.finding: The polyurethane segment does not provide a complete standalone profit bridge for MDI and TDI.
evidence_ledger.implication: The segment margin cannot be mechanically attributed to the MDI moat, and a full-cycle product spread cannot be independently reconstructed.

evidence_ledger.finding: The 2026H1 earnings improvement coincided with MDI/TDI price and supply-demand disruption, with divergent product prices.
evidence_ledger.implication: H1 is treated as a cycle scenario, not a permanent run rate. This assessment rejects simple peak annualization.

evidence_ledger.finding: New materials had only a 10.53% gross margin in 2025 while depreciation increased 32.45% year on year.
evidence_ledger.implication: The segment remains a ramping asset and lacks evidence for a mature specialty-material multiple.

evidence_ledger.finding: Ethylene, PDH and POCHP investments continue, but the allowed evidence does not provide reproducible project-level full-cycle ROIC.
evidence_ledger.implication: Capacity growth is not value growth. These assets require a low-return assumption until post-depreciation returns exceed the cost of capital.

price_snapshot.note: No external quote was introduced. Values below are intrinsic CNY per share and do not constitute a portfolio action.

methods.name: normalized_earnings
methods.note: Even the bull multiple is capped for cyclicality, capital intensity and opaque project returns.

methods.name: enterprise_value_cash_flow
methods.note: Risk-adjusted cash-flow parameters are used. Net debt materially magnifies equity downside in the bear case.
